title: PATHWAYS: Evaluating Investigation and Context Discovery in AI Web Agents
reasoning: The paper introduces a benchmark (PATHWAYS) designed to evaluate the investigative and context-discovery capabilities of AI web agents in functional settings like e-commerce and content moderation. While the benchmark includes components for adversarial safety and sycophancy, these are treated as measures of technical robustness and decision-making integrity rather than as evaluations of moral, ethical, or religious frameworks.
